title.rendered: Voltra Lite — Low Density Single-Wire Knitted Mesh

content.rendered:
Voltra Lite is our low-density, single-wire knitted mesh, knitted on single-needle machines purpose-built for green hydrogen. It is specified where an open structure matters more than density: open gas diffusion layers and elastic elements inside alkaline electrolyser stacks.

Because stitch length and needle gauge are tunable, pore size and stack-cell fit are set per application rather than selected from a catalogue.

excerpt.rendered: Open GDL and elastic-element knitted mesh for alkaline electrolyser stacks.

Wires per needle: Single
Needle gauge: 1
Single-piece diameter: up to 2.2 m
Corrugation: 4-10 mm
Standards: ASTM B164, ISO 9044, DSIR-RDI, ISO 22734-ready QMS
acf.mesh_count: Single wire per needle, needle gauge 1
acf.applications:
Open gas diffusion layer (GDL) / PTL
Nickel elastic elements
Alkaline electrolyser stack core
Balance-of-plant filter elements
